items.Sentence: The existing WWTF consists of a headworks with two mechanical bar screens and an influent meter.
Solids from the screen/compactor are dewatered and deposited in a trash-bin.

The wastewater is then routed to four aerated lagoons ... equipped with small bubble diffused-air aeration devices ... flows by gravity into Aeration Lagoon No. 2 for further aeration and solids settling.
Effluent from the Aeration Lagoons is discharged to the eastern Disposal Ponds, which comprise approximately 30 acres and have a capacity of approximately 236 acre feet.
Use Area that consists of two unlined storage ponds that comprised about 30 acres or about 236 acre-feet of storage (new pond under construction).
Two small effluent storage ponds are located at the southwest corner of the WWTF and are used to deliver effluent to the adjacent farm fields.
The Discharger changed the design of the proposed pond construction and has constructed a separate 30-acre disposal pond east of the existing ponds.
Conceptually the expansion project consists of expanding the capacity of the disposal ponds by adding another 30-acre disposal pond east of the existing disposal pond.
